test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 26 May 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Who among the following dancers is the first transwoman to receive a Padma Shri Award for her contribution to Indian Classical dance?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Narthaki Nataraj.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__****Narthaki Nataraj**

__
 
• Bharatanatyam dancer.
 
• In** 2019, awarded Padma Shri, **making her the first transgender woman to be awarded **India's fourth-highest civilian award.**
 
• She specialises in the **Tanjore-based Nayaki Bhava** tradition.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Transgender folk dancer **Manjamma Jogati received a Padma Shri **honour for her contribution to the arts.

 
 
• President Ram Nath Kovind handed over the award at the 2021 Padma awards ceremony at Rashtrapati Bhavan.
 
 
 
• **Jogati**, is also the** first transwoman President of Karnataka Janapada Academy.**
